info.title: CT Studio delivery bridge
info.description: Producer API of the delivery bridge. Every /v1 request is signed (x-bridge-timestamp, x-bridge-nonce, x-bridge-signature: HMAC-SHA256 of the method, path, timestamp, nonce and body hash).

post.description: Whether each target would take a delivery as the acting user now: it exists, its sink is available, and a personal sink has the user’s connection. Nothing is written.
Accepts one package for one or more targets, all or nothing, and queues one delivery per target.

post.summary: Relay an administration call to a sink
post.description: One administration call (contract version 3) to a sink that declares administration: its instances, its clients or its audit log. The answer is the sink's, with the call's status (200, or 201 for an add or an issue).

delete.description: Refused with 409 while an unfinished delivery names the target. A removed target keeps its id: putting it again is refused with 409.

post.summary: Read an object of a target
Write an object of a target

post.description: A missing object counts as deleted.

post.summary: Browse a sink's tree for a destination or source field
Test target settings before saving them
List a watched folder of a target
post.description: Contract version 4: a watched folder of the target's sink instance, named by `source` (the sink's source fields). The bridge adds the instance and the credential: the target's shared connection, or for a personal sink the acting user's own (409 `connection_missing` without one). A sink that does not declare watched folders is 405 `unsupported_part`; a missing folder is 404 `not_found` with `details.reason: 'folder_missing'`. Its files only, no subfolders.

post.summary: Read a file of a watched folder
post.description: Contract version 4: a watched folder of the target's sink instance, named by `source` (the sink's source fields). The bridge adds the instance and the credential: the target's shared connection, or for a personal sink the acting user's own (409 `connection_missing` without one). A sink that does not declare watched folders is 405 `unsupported_part`; a missing folder is 404 `not_found` with `details.reason: 'folder_missing'`. Answers the file's bytes as `application/octet-stream`. A file over `BRIDGE_MAX_SOURCE_MB` is 422 `content_rejected` with `details.reason: 'too_large'`, refused as it streams.

post.summary: Move a file between watched folders
post.description: Contract version 4: a watched folder of the target's sink instance, named by `source` (the sink's source fields). The bridge adds the instance and the credential: the target's shared connection, or for a personal sink the acting user's own (409 `connection_missing` without one). A sink that does not declare watched folders is 405 `unsupported_part`; a missing folder is 404 `not_found` with `details.reason: 'folder_missing'`. Within one watched location, creating the destination folder as needed. Idempotent: a retried move whose source is gone and whose destination is there succeeds.

post.summary: Write a small text file in a watched folder
post.description: Contract version 4: a watched folder of the target's sink instance, named by `source` (the sink's source fields). The bridge adds the instance and the credential: the target's shared connection, or for a personal sink the acting user's own (409 `connection_missing` without one). A sink that does not declare watched folders is 405 `unsupported_part`; a missing folder is 404 `not_found` with `details.reason: 'folder_missing'`. UTF-8 text of at most 65,536 characters (a reason file).

put.description: Used by the producer to move the keys it held for a target onto the bridge. The secret is encrypted on arrival.

delete.description: Called by the producer when a user is disabled. Shared connections stay.

post.summary: Keep the personal connections of live users only
post.description: The producer sends the ids of its live users; the personal connections of anyone else are deleted. An empty list is refused.
